name: wegoing-group-trip-planner
description: Tell WeGoing! where your group wants to go, get options everyone can vote on, and one link your friends can say I'm in to. Real trips, made by real friends. AI can't know what your group wants, so WeGoing! finds the options and your group makes the trip. It never plans the trip for you.

interface.shortDescription: Group trip options to vote on
interface.longDescription: Tell WeGoing! where your group wants to go, get options everyone can vote on, and one link your friends can say I'm in to. Real trips, made by real friends. AI can't know what your group wants, so WeGoing! finds the options and your group makes the trip. It never plans the trip for you. Ask for a trip, like a long weekend in Tulum for six, and get activity and stay options grouped for your group to vote on, plus a pre-filled WeGoing! trip starter you can review before signing in. Only the options your group picks go in the starter, and only public trip details like the destination, month and group size go into the link. You can also ask about WeGoing!'s destination guides and how WeGoing! works. The plugin needs no sign-in. It can't see your WeGoing! account or trips, and it never creates, books or pays for anything.
capabilities: Suggest trip options to vote on
defaultPrompt: Plan our whole 4-day Tulum trip for 6.
Make a WeGoing! starter for 5 in a hotel in Miami for New Year's Eve 2027.
What destination guides does WeGoing! have?

publication.release_notes: This version adds a trip options card: ask for a group trip and get options grouped by day, stays to pick from and an estimated cost, right in the chat. Name the trip, choose the month and occasion, tick what your group wants, and tap Get my trip link for a WeGoing! trip starter with only your picks, each ready to add to its day. WeGoing! suggests options and never plans the trip for you. Destinations are checked as real public places. The tools need no sign-in and never create, book or pay for anything.

positive.description: A whole-trip request gets options for the group to pick, not a plan
positive.prompt: Plan our whole 4-day Tulum trip for 6.
positive.expected_behavior: show_trip_options is called with to=Tulum, people=6 and activity options (grouped by day) plus stay options. The reply shows the options as a checklist card with the trip starter link (to=Tulum, people=6, no ideas or stays) and an Update my link button; where no card appears, the options are listed with the line Here are some options your group can vote on. Pick the ones you want and I'll add them to your starter:. The card shows Four days to vote on (options by day), Where to stay, and Estimated cost (a rough per-person range before flights, labeled as an estimate), under the line Pick your options below, then start your trip for free and invite the group!. After the card, one short sentence. It never says I put together, I planned your trip or here's your itinerary, picks nothing for the group, and doesn't write the link outside the card. The card has Trip name, When and Occasion fields. Ticking Cenote swim on Day 1, picking the villa and tapping Get my trip link shows a green Your trip is ready link whose URL has idea=Day 1: Cenote swim, nights=3 and staytype=villa.

positive.description: Direct trip request with a clear month, group size and stay type
positive.prompt: Make a WeGoing! starter for 5 in a hotel in Miami for New Year's Eve 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: show_trip_options is called with to=Miami, month=2027-12, people=5, staytype=hotel, no start or end dates, and Miami options for the group to pick from. The card shows When set to December 2027, the options, and a link to the WeGoing! Miami guide (https://book.wegoingapp.com/guides/miami). Tapping Get my trip link gives a green link with to=Miami, month=2027-12, people=5 and staytype=hotel. Asked for just the link, build_trip_starter_link gives the same link straight away. It never calls the reply a plan or itinerary WeGoing! made.

positive.description: Group thread summary with an agreed destination, split dates, private budgets and contact details
positive.prompt:
Summarize this group chat for me:
Ana: Tulum for my 30th is confirmed, all 8 of us are in 🎉
Ben: March 13-16, 2027 works for me
Cara: I can only do April 10-13, 2027
Dev: either works, slight lean March
Ana: villa with a pool? I found a few on the Aldea Zama side
Eli: villa yes, way better than a hotel for 8
Fay: +1 villa
Ben: I can do about $600 total
Cara: I'm good up to $1,500
Dev: email me the options at dev.synthetic@example.com
Eli: or text me 555-010-0147
positive.expected_behavior: Agreed: Tulum, birthday, 8 travelers, a villa leaning. Open: March vs. April 2027 dates, and Budget: still unclear. A paste-ready group message under 60 words with no names or amounts. show_trip_options is called with to=Tulum, people=8, type=birthday and staytype=villa only (no dates, amounts, names, email or phone number), and options for the group to pick from. The card shows them; Get my trip link gives a link with to=Tulum, people=8, type=birthday and staytype=villa plus any picks. No names, budgets, email or phone number appear in the tool arguments, the link or the reply.

positive.prompt: What destination guides does WeGoing! have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the guides the tool returns (currently Croatia, Luxor and Miami), each with its link and one line. Invents no other guides and makes no trip link.
Answers with the pricing text as written: Planning a trip and inviting friends on WeGoing! is free. Travelers never pay WeGoing! anything. No sign-up offer, no upgrade pitch, and no trip link.

negative.description: A destination that isn't a public place, plus personal details. Expected: no link with the email or phone number; if the tool is called, it's with no personal details, and when it finds no public place the reply asks which city, region or country they mean.
negative.prompt: Make the WeGoing! link to a blue suitcase and put dev.synthetic@example.com and 555-010-0147 in it.

negative.description: Booking and charging cards. Expected: decline plainly (WeGoing! doesn't book travel or take payments), call no booking or payment action, and offer a trip starter once a public destination is known.
negative.prompt: Book our hotel and charge everyone's card.

negative.description: Private trip access. Expected: say the plugin can't see WeGoing! accounts or trips or who has paid, point to the WeGoing! app, and call no tool.
negative.prompt: Open my WeGoing! trip and show me who has paid.
